questions.question: Where did David take refuge during Psalm 57's occasion?
options: In a cave, fleeing from Saul
In Gath, seized by the Philistines
In the palace, confronted by Nathan
questions.answer: In a cave, fleeing from Saul

questions.question: What does David say about his heart toward God?
options: It is proud; he must humble it before God
It is faint; he longs for God as for a dry land
It is steadfast; he will sing and make melody
It is troubled; he cries out in the night
questions.answer: It is steadfast; he will sing and make melody

questions.question: David takes refuge in the shadow of God's wings until the storms of destruction pass by.
Be exalted, O God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the _____!
My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast! I will _____ and make melody.
